channel.title: Algo — New Algorithm Digest
channel.description: Periodic digest summarizing newly merged algorithm docs and problem walkthroughs in Algo.

item.title: Heavy-Light Decomposition
item.description: Heavy-Light Decomposition breaks a tree into chains so that path queries and updates can be answered in O(log^2 n) using a Segment Tree.
item.dc:creator: Algo Community

item.title: Persistent Segment Tree
item.description: A Persistent Segment Tree keeps every previous version of itself accessible after an update, enabling efficient queries on historical states of an array.
item.dc:creator: Algo Community

item.title: Sqrt Decomposition
item.description: Sqrt Decomposition is a technique that splits an array into blocks of size sqrt(n) to answer range queries and updates faster than brute force.

item.title: Reverse Bits Solution
item.description: The Reverse Bits problem asks you to reverse the bits of a given 32-bit unsigned integer. Essentially, you need to flip the binary representation of the number so that the least significant bit (LSB) becomes the most significant bit (MSB) and vice versa.

item.title: Finding Power of Factorial Divisor
item.description: Legendre's Formula calculates the largest exponent x such that k^x divides n!, the factorial of a number, by summing the quotients of n divided by successive powers of k.
